summary: Pilot-only diagnostics: bootstrap F-score selection frequencies, screen stability across seeds, and nested-CV AUC of an RF on majority-kept features.
reasoning: The sibling screened-forest route was refuted twice (RF on pilot-screened features missed the floor) while selection inside CV with 30 features cleared it, so I must not assume the first screen works. This run measures, strictly on the 400-row pilot: the frequency landscape of bootstrap top-k selection, how repeatable the majority set is across screen seeds, and an honest nested-CV (screen refit inside every outer fold, small inner grid for RF max_features/min_samples_leaf) to see whether the design clears cv_auc 0.70 and how many features majority voting keeps. No heldout access. Numbers here are diagnostics; the locked estimate will be a separate run writing out/metrics.json.
